equivalentQuery: SELECT o.OrderId, c.Name AS CustomerName, o.Total FROM dbo.Customers AS c JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId AND o.Status IN (N'Paid', N'Pending') WHERE c.IsActive = 1 ORDER BY o.OrderId;
negativeQuery: SELECT o.OrderId, c.Name AS CustomerName, o.Total FROM dbo.Orders AS o CROSS JOIN dbo.Customers AS c WHERE c.IsActive = 1 ORDER BY o.OrderId;
